nodes.text:
Yogyakarta International Airport (YIA) authorities will tighten surveillance and conduct health screening to anticipate the spread of Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV).

All passengers and crew that arrive at the airport will be checked by the Yogyakarta Health Quarantine Center (BKK) https://t.co/Y2Lo5DYo5r
